  "system_description": "The Monitor Temperature system receives current air temperature with status and operator-specified lower and upper alarm temperatures with status. It provides an on/off alarm command to an alarm component and monitor status to the operator interface. Its modeled boundary contains monitor-interface management, alarm management, monitor-mode management, and internal-failure detection processes. Internal connections distribute temperature inputs, alarm limits, monitor mode, and failure indications. The selected window specifies structure and interfaces; detailed behavior is defined outside this window. requirements.statement: The Monitor Temperature system shall provide an output data port named monitor_status, of type Isolette_Data_Model::Status, indicating Init, On/operating, or Failed status.
The Monitor Temperature system shall connect its upper_alarm_tempWstatus input to the monitor-interface management process's upper_alarm_tempWstatus input through connection muat.

The Monitor Temperature system shall connect its current_tempWstatus input to the monitor-mode management process's current_tempWstatus input through connection mctm.
The Monitor Temperature system shall connect the alarm management process's alarm_control output to its external alarm_control output through connection malrm.

The Monitor Temperature system shall connect the monitor-failure detection process's internal_failure output to the monitor-mode management process's internal_failure input through connection mif.

The monitor-interface management process shall contain a thread part named mmi of type Manage_Monitor_Interface_i.
